strings: For as long as m_c can remember, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} have had delusional beliefs that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} just couldn't let go of.
It seems m_c's delusions were not just a one-time thing. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/mave/has} delusional disorder.
After seeing m_c hold a clearly false belief for the second time this week, r_c gently suggests that m_c may have delusional disorder.
The healer has diagnosed m_c with delusional disorder.
